evidence: Built the criterion -> requirement map for all 54 criteria (render gate 1, constraints gate 2, functional 42, polish 6, visual 3). Every graded demand traces to a public line or an ordinary professional default; no criterion asserts an exact label, route, selector, colour value, message wording or schema, and no criterion signs in (instruction.md and app_context.md both say there is no sign-in, so the workbook's internal login annotation and the skill's sign-in false positive do not arise). Mapping: (1) editor keys, line join, sticky column, graphemes, mouse selection, selection replace, single-undo paste, block indent, caret in view, Ctrl+Home/End, long unwrapped line, multi-caret with both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click, same-line carets, slow burst as one Undo, Undo restoring the caret, keyboard Undo/Redo -> environment/instructions/ui.md:5,7,9 (e.g. 'Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End (Cmd on a Mac) jump to the start and end of the document', 'Allow both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click to add carets', 'Undo puts the caret back where it was before the undone edit'). (2) Find/Replace criteria including literal dot/bracket, wrap, move-to-following match, self-containing replacement, Replace all one Undo, new edit clears Redo -> ui.md:11. (3) JS five-category and HTML four-category colouring distinct from each other and from plain names, same at declaration and call -> ui.md:13; the criteria say 'No fixed colour values are required' and 'Do not require a particular DOM tag or CSS class'. (4) Format: two-space nesting, idempotence, one Undo/Redo, error leaves draft -> ui.md:15 and ui.md:9 ('Formatting a document that is already formatted changes nothing and adds no Undo step'); 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure' removes a formatter-specific default. (5) Run, fresh document, console order, message plus one-based line for thrown errors, whole-file HTML line and unhandled rejections, output kept before failure, last-good restore with input values and canvas, five-second budget, fresh budget after interaction, Stop and superseded runs -> behaviour.md:3,5,7. (6) Preview isolation and refusal of eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import with a harmless-strings control -> security.md:3,5 ('fetch requests to outside addresses or to this app's own routes must fail'). (7) Save/reload/restart, stale save refused, dirty draft kept, history inspection, restore adds a revision, repeated restore adds none, old-revision restore does not overwrite, live library within about five seconds without disturbing draft/caret/scroll/Undo/fields, newer-revision notice -> behaviour.md:9,11,13 and integration.md:7,9. (8) Polish: keyboard reach and visible focus, shown way out of the editor, worded feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, disabled Undo/Redo after New and after opening, unsaved marker, 390 px -> ui.md:17 and ui.md:9. (9) Constraint gate marker list (cm-editor, CodeMirror, monaco-editor, ace_editor, ProseMirror, tiptap, ql-editor, data-slate-editor, DraftEditor) matches the editors named in ui.md:3, and it keeps the public allowance: 'A small input or textarea that is used only to receive keyboard or clipboard events is allowed'. Hidden-requirement guards are present in the judge text: functional/prompt.md:21 'Match controls by purpose and label, never by exact wording or selectors', :22 'Do not guess URL paths or API routes', :24 'Grade only the steps written in each criterion. Extra probes must not fail a criterion when its listed steps passed'. Conforming alternatives tried against the text: restore idempotency by base-revision refusal or by request id both satisfy cw_history_restore_retry, and a non-replayable transport is exempted ('leave this one step out without failing the criterion for it'); a second-tab restore may be 'either refused or added on top'; a preview hosted on another local origin instead of an opaque sandbox still satisfies the localStorage leg of cw_preview_isolation; single-caret typing undone per character or per run both satisfy cw_undo_restores_caret and cw_custom_typing_and_line_join; Find starting at the first match or before it is accepted ('the first occurrence may already be current as soon as the literal is entered'); timing windows of ten seconds are looser than the public 'about five seconds'. Scripted golden results on these bytes show every criterion id true (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json), which is scripted evidence only; no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so whether the judge itself adds unwritten demands is unmeasured. Two observations recorded as notes, neither judged a defect: (a) cw_html_preview (functional/judge.toml:227) asks for 'a button whose inline handler changes visible text'. No note mentions event-handler attributes, and the golden needs dedicated code for them (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:335-340 rewrites on* attributes into nonce scripts; :363 adds script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'), so an app that isolates the preview with a nonce-only CSP and does no such rewriting would fail this criterion. I treat working onclick attributes as the professional default for 'A complete .html file replaces that document' (behaviour.md:3), and security.md:5 does not list handler attributes among the refused forms, so this is required behaviour rather than a golden-only rule. (b) cw_long_line_editing (judge.toml:92) says 'The line must be shown unwrapped as one logical line'; ui.md:7 says 'The editor must keep a long unwrapped line horizontally reachable', which I read as requiring no soft wrap, and the fail clause only names 'wrapped into several numbered lines'.
